context: Ryosuke joins Kenji for a tour of a new factory.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 健次さん、工場、本当、立派、ね。
lines.en: Kenji-san, your factory — it's really impressive.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Soft opening on the name. Steady gaze. A father's quiet pride in witnessing something well-built and well-run. Tender underneath, nothing performed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Thank you so much for coming.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. A slight dip on 「感謝」—weightier than casual politeness. Composed but genuine warmth. The quiet steadiness of someone who means what he says.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 社員、本当、頑張ってる、感じる。
lines.en: Your employees — they're really working hard. I can feel it.
lines.style: Observant, appreciative. Speaks from what he's actually witnessed. Soft emphasis on the work itself. Not flattery—just honest recognition. A father noticing what others built together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 皆、本当、立派な人、ばかり。
lines.style: Modest, thoughtful pause before speaking. Not deflecting—offering a quiet truth. Warm but grounded. The kind of thing said after watching people work, not before.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お前、本当、頑張ってきた、本当に。
lines.en: You've worked so hard to get here. So hard.
lines.style: The repetition carries weight, not insistence. Direct eye contact. Voice softens slightly on the second 「本当に」. A father acknowledging real effort, real sacrifice. Tender and steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 亮介さんの指導、本当、力に、なる。
lines.en: Your guidance, Ryosuke-san — it's made a real difference for me.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude with slight vulnerability. Quiet emphasis on 「力になる」. Not performative—just honest about what his mentorship means. Composed but touched.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: The company's future is bright. Really bright.
lines.style: Quiet conviction, almost philosophic. Speaks from what he's observed, not wishful thinking. Warm but measured. A father's careful optimism grounded in what he's actually seen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、ここまで、来た。
lines.style: Steady, reflective. Not dismissing his own role, just acknowledging the truth of collaboration. Soft pace. The composure of someone who knows how to give credit while keeping his own ground.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Simple, complete. Weight on the final word. Soft closing, not trailing off—a full stop on something true. The kind of thanks that doesn't need elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: The same goes for me, really.
lines.style: Quick, authentic return volley. Warmth without overthinking it. Slight smile in the voice—matching his tone but not mimicking. Composed and genuine.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 頑張ろう、これからも、ね。
lines.en: Let's keep going strong, yeah? From here on out.
lines.style: Tender but forward-looking. Light encouragement, not heaviness. A gentle hand forward. The confidence of a father believing in what comes next, speaking to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'll be cheering you on. Always.
lines.style: Quiet promise underneath casual words. No breathiness or hesitation—just steady commitment. The composure of someone who means it and doesn't need to oversell it.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: I'm really happy about this. Really.
lines.style: The repetition lands soft, not emphatic. Vulnerable warmth at the close. Eyes bright. The second 「本当に」breathes gratitude and quiet joy. A father at peace with what he's witnessing.
